SparkGlade_Text_Npc0.en: The air here is full of charge. My\nhair stands up, even my POKéMON's.
SparkGlade_Text_Npc0.fr: L'air ici est plein de charge. Mes\ncheveux se dressent, même ceux de\lmon POKéMON.

SparkGlade_Text_Npc1.en: I touched a VOLTORB. It was a\nmistake.
SparkGlade_Text_Npc1.fr: J'ai touché un VOLTORBE. C'était\nune erreur.

SparkGlade_Text_Quest0_Ask.en: My coils drain fast. Bring me 2\nELIXIRS and I will give you a\pprototype.
SparkGlade_Text_Quest0_Ask.fr: Mes bobines se vident vite.\nApporte-moi 2 ÉLIXIRS et je te\ldonne un prototype.

SparkGlade_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
SparkGlade_Text_Quest0_NoRoomT.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

SparkGlade_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

SparkGlade_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
